nodes.name: Process One Product at a Time

parameters.content:
## 📦 Real-Time Inventory & Auto-Reorder Pipeline

Checks every active product against its reorder threshold, automatically drafts and sends a purchase order for anything running low, and keeps the inventory sheet and reorder log up to date.

**Perfect for:** Operations and supply chain teams who manage inventory in Google Sheets and want low stock reordering handled automatically.

---

## How it works

1. **Manual Trigger**: Starts a run on demand. *(alternative entry point)*
2. **Check Every 4 Hours**: A scheduled alternative that runs the same check automatically. *(currently disabled)*
3. **Get Active Products**: Pulls every product row from the Inventory sheet.
4. **Process One Product at a Time**: Loops through the product list one row at a time.
5. **Calculate Stock Level & Urgency**: Computes stock percentage, urgency level, reorder quantity, and estimated cost for the product.
6. **Update Last Checked Date**: Writes the current check date back to the Inventory sheet for that product.
7. **Needs Reorder?**: Branches based on whether stock has fallen at or below the reorder threshold.
8. **Already Reordered Today?**: Guards against sending a duplicate purchase order for a product already reordered today.
9. **Generate PO Message**: Drafts a purchase order Slack message using the *OpenAI — PO Model*, including product, quantity, cost, and supplier details.
10. **Slack — Send Purchase Order**: Posts the generated purchase order to the reorder Slack channel.
11. **Update Inventory — Reorder Triggered**: Updates the Inventory sheet with the new reorder date and count.
12. **Log to Reorder Log Sheet**: Appends a full record of the reorder to the Reorder_Log sheet, then loops back for the next product.
13. **Slack — Summary Report**: Once every product has been checked, posts a summary confirming the run completed.
14. **Error Trigger**: Catches any workflow failure. *(currently disabled)*
15. **🚨 Slack Error Alert**: Posts the failed node and error message to Slack. *(currently disabled)*

---

## Setup (~15 minutes)

1. **Google Sheets**: Connect your account in *Get Active Products*, *Update Last Checked Date*, *Update Inventory — Reorder Triggered*, and *Log to Reorder Log Sheet*, pointing each at your own spreadsheet.
2. **OpenAI**: Add your API key in *OpenAI — PO Model*.
3. **Slack**: Connect your account and set the reorder channel in *Slack — Send Purchase Order*, the summary channel in *Slack — Summary Report*, and optionally the alerts channel in *🚨 Slack Error Alert*.
4. **Schedule**: Enable *Check Every 4 Hours* if you want automatic runs instead of triggering manually.
> *Error Trigger* and *🚨 Slack Error Alert* are disabled by default; enable both together if you want failure notifications.

## 1️⃣ Trigger, Fetch & Failsafe

**Manual Trigger** or the disabled **Check Every 4 Hours** schedule starts each run, with the disabled **Error Trigger** and **🚨 Slack Error Alert** pair sitting alongside them ready to be switched on for failure notifications. **Get Active Products** pulls the full product list from the Inventory sheet, and **Process One Product at a Time** loops through it one row at a time.

## 2️⃣ Stock Evaluation & Summary

**Calculate Stock Level & Urgency** works out the stock percentage, urgency level, and reorder quantity for the current product, and **Update Last Checked Date** records that the check happened. **Needs Reorder?** filters out products that are still adequately stocked, **Already Reordered Today?** stops a duplicate purchase order going out, and once every product has cycled through, **Slack — Summary Report** posts a completion summary.

## 3️⃣ Purchase Order Generation

**Generate PO Message** drafts a purchase order message using the **OpenAI — PO Model**, pulling in the product, supplier, quantity, and cost details, and **Slack — Send Purchase Order** posts it straight to the reorder channel.
